u0: The box is not yet in hand. Move to the purple box, face it, and pick it up to make holding_box true and advance to the carrying phase. Nothing else counts until the box is held.
u1: You are carrying the box. Keep it in your hands while heading for the green exit in the bottom-right corner; reaching the exit while still holding the box is the goal. If the box slips (box_fell), you will drop to recovery instead.
u2: The box has just fallen out of your hands and is no longer carried. Locate the fallen box, move to it, face it, and pick it up again with empty hands to return to carrying the box toward the exit.
u3: Finished: you reached the exit while carrying the box, so the task is complete and the reward has been paid. No further action is needed.
